resource_mapping_note: The policy sets memory_bytes_per_job and memory_swap_bytes_per_job both to 8 GiB. This means zero additional swap when the launcher maps memory_swap as Docker total memory+swap; if a launcher maps it to cgroup memory.swap.max, it permits 8 GiB extra swap and violates the no-extra-swap requirement. Native integration must document/verify the exact mapping before any dispatch.
review_scope: Read-only policy content review before heavy jobs; no policy or scripts edited, no native/simulation jobs run.
